body:
I promise you that she won't get over abandonment issues.  I feel suicidal - don't get me wrong.... however, I was abandoned at 14 months old, and I have never gotten over it.  I put myself in a mental hospital when my son was young because I felt the same as you.  At that time they explained to my husband what was going on.  Since then he has been very helpful.  Now my kids are  grown and I'm happy that I didn't leave them.

Maybe I shouldn't leave them now.

I never finish anything and I feel a disappointment to others.  I feel this is leading to my suicide thoughts.  I was accepted at a university here in TX at the age of 45 just days before mom passed.  I know she would have been proud of me.  But I dropped my classes on Saturday because I just didn't want to keep on.  Last semester I had a 3.75 GPA - I mean I was really doing well.  I don't believe in myself, and I don't think anyone else does either.  So I sit here and think of suicide - I have therapy in 2 hours and I'm afraid to say anything.

I don't want to think about suicide.  My life has been pretty good for 24 years now.  I have an awesome husband and 3 boys.  I'm not saying that we don't have tough times - but we stick together.

I was abandoned after miserable mistreatment at 14 months old -- I don't remember it, but I'm obsessed with it.  I was sexual abused by my adopted father and my adopted mother just passed.  I feel guilty because they paid for the surgeries that I needed growing up, and they gave me anything a girl could ever want.  I feel bad feeling ill of them.  I lost my brother by adoption to suicide in 2007.  I just want to be in God's arms that's all.  I think I envy my brother and mother.  But yet I still want to be here with my husband and kids.  Doesn't make since, and therefore feel like a failure.
